title: Lebesgue points for a measure with n-dimensional growth (Besicovitch differentiation)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, nu a measure on the Borel sets of R^(n+l), f : R^(n+l) -> R nu-integrable, and C real with nu(B_r(z)) <= C r^n for every z and every r > 0 (B_r closed balls; the inequality is in [0, infinity] via ENNReal.ofReal). Then for nu-a.e. y, ENNReal.ofReal (r^{-n}) * (lintegral over B_r(y) of the extended norm |f(w) - f(y)|_e dnu(w)) tends to 0 in [0, infinity] as r -> 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Integrable f ν → (∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ν (closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ w in closedBall y r, ‖f w - f y‖ₑ ∂ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
